title: Behaviors and rules belong in the Skill or Lug file that governs them
description: When a behavioral rule or protocol convention is discussed, it must be codified in the relevant Skill .md file (e.g. wai.md for wakeup rules, wai-closeout.md for closeout rules) or as a policy lug. Not just in chat or state fields. CLAUDE.md is a pointer only - rules live in skills.
_v1_type_code: Behaviors and rules belong in the Skill or Lug file that governs them
